positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Automated network management tools for engineers saving thousands of dollars in labor costs.
• Worked in a full stack environment with a HTML/JS/Bootstrap frontend, Python/Flask backend. connected to a MySQL database. Used jQuery/Ajax/Requests for client side interactions and various APIs/libraries for server side functions.
• Owned life cycle for features (design, implementation, test, document), and prioritized scalability and efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Collected business requirements for a supply chain modeling tool, and developed a DevOps framework to build the platform.
• Implemented an interactive map of the US using JavaScript, HTML and the Google Maps API.
• Created an object-oriented Java backend that reads JSON data of suppliers and allows the user to search for delivery speed  and other factors for given parts.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: IT Infrastructure Intern
positions.description:
• Built, provisioned, and decommissioned Linux and Windows virtual machines using IT software management tools.
• Monitored and remediated security risks generated by Kenna and Red Hat.
• Organized a maintenance calendar in Microsoft SharePoint.
• Worked with engineers on day-to-day tasks such as generating error logs and updating web certificates.

positions.title: Sponsorship Coordinator
positions.description:
• Connected with sponsors, applied for grants, and advertised.
• Attended meetings and oversaw/planned for our events.
